title: Lamb Moussaka
description: Layered Greek casserole of aubergine, potato and spiced lamb mince under a light béchamel.
steps: Fry the aubergine slices until golden, then brown the lamb mince separately.
Cook the onion and garlic, return the lamb, add cinnamon and tomatoes, and simmer until thick.
Layer the potato, aubergine and meat sauce in a dish, top with a simple béchamel, and bake at 200C for 50 minutes.

source.label: Adapted from BBC Good Food moussaka

notes: A weekend project dish — make it a day ahead, as moussaka reheats and slices even better the next day.
